caption: A tall, narrow orange-yellow flame burns against a black frame, its base anchored low on the left, the tip rising and flickering. The flame is already alight at the start and still burns at the end. As the action progresses, the tip, starting left-leaning, tends to shift rightward relative to the base, so the flame sways from a left-leaning posture toward an upright, slightly right-leaning one. Its height and width pulse subtly over time, while the body's brightness also fluctuates. To the right, a smaller dimmer orange ember appears and fades, flickering in and out rather than translating. Several faint points of light—a white dot near the upper center, a white dot at the far right, and tiny orange specks—remain at nearly identical positions throughout. The background points appear fixed, suggesting a stationary camera. The flame's sway and flicker, along with the ember's pulsing, are the main visible changes.
